notes.title: New Modes
notes.notes: [p]New Modes[/p][p]-Arena[/p][p]-Bank[/p][p]-Hardcore[/p][p]-Wastelands[/p][p][/p][p]Mortal Valley has been upgraded with new ways to play the game. When your inventory is full, you can simply save your game and bring your loot to the bank to store it. [/p][p]If waiting til dusk for your foes to come and find you takes too long, the arena is the perfect place for you. Battle it out against various monsters to gain some more experience, before stepping into the larger world. [/p][p]If you like taking it a step further, you can also try our hardcore mode, to test your survival skills.[/p][p]At last there are the wastelands, a long ever stretching abys of rock and crystals. Beware, for enemies lurk everywhere and it might be wise to start digging. [/p][p][/p][p]This update has brought the game to a more complete state, though the developer will be expanding upon the game very soon. [/p]
